A machine that can't be predicted kept giving people what they wanted.

Kevin Trudeau describes an experiment with a random number generator. It should land near fifty-fifty every time. Researchers asked a person to simply desire more ones than zeros.

The ones came out ahead, again and again. Kevin says the researchers were blown away, and he calls it evidence that the mind can affect outcomes of chance.

When did you last feel your own focus change how a day went?
